derivation: a primitive root (rather identical with H7034 (קָלָה) through the idea of shrinkage by heat);
def: to toast, i.e. scorch partially or slowly

occurrences.text: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the Lord, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.
And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.
For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon, saying, The Lord make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;
